evidence: Requirement-to-criterion map in per-row-review/evidence/26/coverage-map.json covers the main execution, console, saved-history, security, and UI asks but exposes three gaps. (1) environment/instructions/integration.md:13 mandates Express, better-sqlite3, Node built-ins, one local server and no external backend/database service; tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:29 explicitly disclaims proving Express or SQLite, and tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:7 prohibits implementation/database inspection. (2) environment/instructions/behaviour.md:13 requires preserving ordinary 2D canvas drawings in the actual last-good picture. The S10 protocol paints and expects a red rectangle (tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:275-286), but cw_js_error_rollback full-credit description at tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:168 names B text and the edited input only; Stop/timeout rollback criteria use text controls. (3) integration.md:7-9 requires honoring supplied DB_PATH; tests/test.sh:97-110 normally supplies the same /app/app.db default, so a hardcoded-default app can pass persistence/restart observations. Source-confirmed coverage gaps; no configured judge, Oracle, model or portal outcome claimed. The raw index lists 77 artifacts and every current SHA256 matches, but its scripted results do not measure these scoring gaps.
counterexample: A broken implementation can use a Node HTTP server and JSON flat file or remote service instead of mandated Express/SQLite/local storage; hardcode /app/app.db rather than honor a different DB_PATH; and restore DOM text/input while losing painted canvas pixels. It can satisfy the named browser criteria and normal-path restart readbacks while violating explicit public instructions. A conforming Express/SQLite implementation with alternative control labels or server-rendered library responses remains accepted by the stated browser protocols, so those design choices do not explain the gaps.
suggested_fix: Align the public note with the browser-verifiable contract by removing unsupported technology/backend mandates, or add an authorized non-browser check without changing shared harness policy. Require the already observed canvas bitmap in cw_js_error_rollback full-credit wording (and applicable Stop/timeout preservation probes). Deliberately test DB_PATH at a non-default path within an authorized task-specific runtime check, or narrow the public path claim.
